commands.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import datetime,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
r=Path.cwd(); e=r/'results/raw'/('isolated_colab_build_'+datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ'));e.mkdir()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def scan(b):return {str(p.relative_to(r)):sha(p) for p in sorted(b.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and not p.is_relative_to(e)}
old=r/'results/raw/colab_t4_diagnostics_20261011T005409276199Z'
seal=json.loads((old/'FINAL_INTEGRITY.json').read_text());assert all(sha(old/p)==h for p,h in seal['evidence_sha256'].items())
expected=json.loads((old/'BEFORE.json').read_text())
assert all(sha(r/p)==h for k in ['project_sha256','build_metadata_sha256'] for p,h in expected[k].items())
policy=json.loads((r/'docs/NON_TIMING_TEST_SELECTION_v1.json').read_text())
assert all(sha(r/p)==h for p,h in policy['reviewed_source_sha256'].items())
freeze=r/'docs/studies/cpu_gpu_comparison_v1.freeze.json';assert sha(freeze)=='518ac535473e50fb61dab3a70858bdfe42dfdb43570f649174f44bffe40e1ac6'
assert all(sha(r/p)==h for p,h in json.loads(freeze.read_text())['files_sha256'].items())
b={'prior_results_sha256':scan(r/'results'),'project_sha256':expected['project_sha256'],'build_metadata_sha256':expected['build_metadata_sha256'],'previous_evidence_verified':len(seal['evidence_sha256']),'authorization':'User explicitly authorized reviewed source transfer, new isolated build, narrowly scoped correctness validation; no study/timing trials'}
with (e/'BEFORE.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(b,f,indent=2,sort_keys=True);f.write('\n')
print(e.relative_to(r));print({k:len(v) for k,v in b.items() if k.endswith('sha256')})
PY
